title: 第25章 河伯动手第26章 拾荒者
content_zh:
夜晚的小院中，几个猎人手持长刀和斧头，直接朝着童青山招呼过去。
童青山冷笑，长枪出刺如雨点，速度快到模糊。
一时间，几声闷哼传来，河灵带的几个猎人，顿时都软倒在了地上，血流小院。
只有还未动手的河灵，依旧站在那里。
此刻，童青山长枪指着河灵：“说，你们想做什么？”
河灵竟然不怕童青山，她冷声道：“童青山，你以为，你能在我们村耀武扬威？”
下一秒，河灵的嘴里，忽然哼唱起了一阵诡异的歌谣：“河伯上我身，我身河伯身，爷爷奶奶快显灵，河伯上我身……”
她的语调怪异，一股诡异的气息，从小院外席卷过来，忽然包裹住了河灵。
“嗯？”童青山目光一凝，不再犹豫，长枪直接刺向河灵。
然而，河灵的身体，却好像是虚化了，童青山一枪刺过去，竟然只刺中了一个影子。
下一秒，河灵的身影，出现在了童青山的身体一侧，仿佛会瞬移。
并且，此时的河灵，两脚不沾地，面无表情，整个人就好像是一个会飞的鬼，悬在空中，眼睛直勾勾的盯着童青山。
“装神弄鬼！”童青山怒道，再次出枪，扎向河灵。
河灵却再次消失了，她的身影，又出现在了童青山的背后。
此刻，小葡萄也醒了，张楚于是带着小葡萄来到了院子里。
看到这种情况，张楚顿时说道：“青山，用神纹！”
童青山顿时点头，他的气势爆发开，背后浮现出十二颗灿烂星辰！
紧接着，童青山长枪横扫，十二颗星辰同时明灭，一道道金色的神纹扩散，笼罩了河灵周围。
河灵再也躲不开，神纹扫中了河灵，她闷哼一声，倒飞了出去，坠落在地上，口吐鲜血，脸色一下子变的苍白。
而就在此刻，小葡萄忽然指着院子门口：“它跑了！”

“谁跑了？”张楚问道，同时看向了门口，但什么都没看到。
此时小葡萄说道：“是一个老头，弯着腰，拄着杖，它脚没动，飘了出去。”
张楚心中一动，看来，刚刚动手的，并不是河灵，而是这个村的守护神。
“河伯村……河伯么？”张楚沉吟，感觉有些不妙。
一般来说，守护神不参与村民们之间的纷争。
但守护神的实力，却毋庸置疑，绝对高于童青山。
因为，守护神可以抵挡妖墟的夜，但童青山却不能。
而此刻，童青山一步上前，长枪抵住了河灵的脖子。
“说，你们想做什么？”童青山怒道。
河灵嘴角流血，一脸的难以置信：“不可能，不可能，你怎么可能打败我！这不可能！”
童青山的长枪轻轻往前一捅，长枪划破了河灵的脖子：“别废话，说你们想要做什么。”
河灵顿时一个激灵，急忙求饶：“我们没有恶意，我们只是想让你们留下来。”
说着，河灵还从怀中取出来两颗湿漉漉的，如樱桃一样的鲜艳小果子，开口道：“你们看，只要你们吃了这个它，你们就不会离开我们村了。”
童青山没有做声，而是看向了张楚。
张楚则开口道：“为什么只有两颗果子？你们想对小葡萄做什么？”
河灵不敢隐瞒：“河伯看上了她，他要我们织一张草席，把小葡萄放在草席上，送入河里。”
“什么！”童青山顿时恼怒：“你们的守护神，吃人？”
河灵却说道：“不是吃人，是娶妾，我们的守护神每隔三年要娶一次妾，能被守护神选中，是天大的福分。”
“我们村的女人，做梦都盼着能去河神的身边，每个人都打扮好，就是为了能被河神点名，去陪伴河神。”
说到这里，河灵看向了小葡萄：“多有福气的孩子啊，刚刚到来就被河神看中了，能做河神的妾，那是多少女人盼都盼不来的福气。”
content_en:
In the small courtyard at night, several hunters held long knives and axes and greeted Tong Qingshan directly.
Tong Qingshan sneered, and the spear came out like raindrops, the speed was so fast that it was blurry.
Suddenly, several muffled groans were heard, and several hunters led by He Ling suddenly fell to the ground, and their blood flowed into the small courtyard.
Only He Ling, who had not yet taken action, was still standing there.
At this moment, Tong Qingshan pointed his spear at He Ling: "Tell me, what do you want to do?"
He Ling was not afraid of Tong Qingshan. She said coldly: "Tong Qingshan, do you think you can show off your power in our village?"
The next second, He Ling's mouth suddenly hummed a strange song: "He Bo is on my body, I am on He Bo's body, my grandparents will appear soon, He Bo is on my body..."
Her tone was strange, and a strange aura swept over from outside the small courtyard and suddenly enveloped He Ling.
"Huh?" Tong Qingshan's eyes narrowed, he no longer hesitated, and stabbed He Ling directly with his spear.
However, He Ling's body seemed to have become insubstantial. Tong Qingshan stabbed him with a spear, but only hit a shadow.
The next second, He Ling's figure appeared on the side of Tong Qingshan's body, as if he could teleport.
Moreover, at this time, He Ling's feet were not touching the ground and his face was expressionless. He was like a flying ghost, hanging in the air, staring directly at Tong Qingshan.
"Pretend to be a ghost!" Tong Qingshan said angrily, and took out his gun again, aiming at He Ling.
He Ling disappeared again, and her figure appeared behind Tong Qingshan again.
At this moment, Little Putao also woke up, and Zhang Chu took Little Putao to the yard.
Seeing this situation, Zhang Chu immediately said: "Qingshan, use divine patterns!"
Tong Qingshan nodded immediately, his momentum exploded, and twelve brilliant stars appeared behind him!
Immediately afterwards, Tong Qingshan's spear swept across, twelve stars flickered and extinguished at the same time, and golden divine patterns spread, covering the surroundings of He Ling.
He Ling could no longer hide away, and the divine pattern hit He Ling. She groaned, flew out, and fell to the ground, vomiting blood, and her face suddenly turned pale.
And at this moment, Little Putao suddenly pointed at the door of the yard: "It ran away!"
"Who ran away?" Zhang Chu asked, looking at the door but seeing nothing.
At this time, Little Putao said: "It's an old man, bent over and leaning on a stick. His feet didn't move and he floated out."
Zhang Chu's heart moved. It seemed that the one who had just taken action was not He Ling, but the patron saint of this village.
"He Bo Village... He Bo?" Zhang Chu pondered, feeling a little bad.
Generally speaking, the patron saint does not take part in the disputes between villagers.
But there is no doubt that the strength of the patron saint is definitely higher than Tong Qingshan.
Because the patron saint can resist Yaoxu Ye, but Tong Qingshan cannot.
At this moment, Tong Qingshan stepped forward and put his spear against He Ling's neck.
"Tell me, what do you want to do?" Tong Qingshan asked angrily.
He Ling's mouth was bleeding, with a look of disbelief on his face: "Impossible, impossible, how could you defeat me! This is impossible!"
Tong Qingshan's spear was gently thrust forward, and the spear cut He Ling's neck: "Stop talking nonsense and tell me what you want to do."
Helingn was agitated and hurriedly begged for mercy: "We have no ill intentions, we just want you to stay."
As he spoke, He Ling took out two wet, bright cherries-like fruits from his arms and said, "Look, as long as you eat these, you will not leave our village."
Tong Qingshan said nothing, but looked at Zhang Chu.
Zhang Chuze said: "Why are there only two fruits? What do you want to do with the little grapes?"
He Ling did not dare to hide it: "He Bo fell in love with her. He asked us to weave a straw mat, put the little grapes on the straw mat, and send it into the river."
"What!" Tong Qingshan was immediately angry: "Your patron saint cannibalizes people?"
But He Ling said: "It's not about eating people, it's about taking concubines. Our guardianThe patron saint has to marry a concubine every three years, so it is a great blessing to be chosen by the patron saint. "
“The women in our village all dream about going to the River God. Everyone dresses up just to be named by the River God and to accompany the River God. "
Having said this, He Ling looked at Little Putao: "What a blessed child. He was spotted by the River God just after he arrived. To be the concubine of the River God is a blessing that many women can't hope for. "
